faq.title: Frequently Asked Questions
faq.subtitle: Find immediate answers to common questions before sending a transmission.
faq.q1: How can I apply as a speaker for TEDxAlkawmia 2026?
faq.a1: Select 'Speaker Proposal / Idea' in the contact form or email curation@tedxalkawmia.org directly. Include a 2-minute video pitch, a short summary of your core premise, and why your idea matters to our community.
faq.q2: How are tickets allocated under the 100-seat license?
faq.a2: Due to official TED licensing constraints, each live edition is strictly limited to 100 seats. Seats are booked via our real-time ticket hold system on the Events page on a first-come, verified checkout basis.
faq.q3: How can my organization become a supporting partner?
faq.a3: We provide audited sponsorship tiers ranging from Title Threshold Partners to individual Student Seat Grants. Reach out to partners@tedxalkawmia.org to request our official 2026 Partnership Deck.
